theorem: For the nonnegative weighted 5x5 grid source of frontier-20261028-grid55-weighted-coordinate-theorem-v1.json SHA256 f1e892255a20d6c3b23afa42994a5fe90feea3be1cb63979a135e6da3ea702c6, let alpha,beta,delta,b,c,q be weights of A=|02>+|11>+|20>, V=|01>, W=|10>, B=|12>+|34>, C=|21>+|43>, Q=|22>+|33>, respectively. Assume alpha,beta,delta,b,c,q>0. If (alpha^2/delta)*(1/c+|r|^2/q)<=1, then the Alice map K|0,1,2,3>=|0,1,2,3>, K|4>=r|3> yields SN<=2. If (alpha^2/beta)*(1/b+|r|^2/q)<=1, the corresponding Bob map yields SN<=2. Every further local map on the opposite side preserves this bound. No PPT assumption is needed for the decomposition; when the source is PPT the output is an actual PPT state.
alice_proof: After the Alice map, C'=|21>+r|33>, Q'=|22>+|33>, and Y=C'-rQ'=|21>-r|22>. For z^4=1 put q_z=sqrt(alpha)*A'+z*sqrt(delta)|10>+conjugate(z)*(alpha/sqrt(delta))*Y. On rows0,1,2 and Bob columns0,1,2 the nonzero rows are [0,0,sqrt(alpha)], [z*sqrt(delta),sqrt(alpha),0], and [sqrt(alpha),conjugate(z)*alpha/sqrt(delta),-r*conjugate(z)*alpha/sqrt(delta)]. The third row is a linear combination of the first two; the fourth row vanishes. Thus each q_z has SR<=2. The phase average consumes alpha[A']+delta[10]+(alpha^2/delta)[Y]. The only nontrivial remainder is the Gram diag(c,q)-(alpha^2/delta)*(1,-r)*(1,-r)^* over (C',Q'), whose entire span occupies Alice rows2,3 and therefore has SR<=2. Its PSD condition is precisely the stated inequality. Every other source generator remains SR<=2 with nonnegative weight.
bob_proof: Under the Bob map, B'=|12>+r|33>, Q'=|22>+|33>, so Y=B'-rQ'=|12>-r|22>. Replace W,delta,C,c above by V,beta,B,b. The first two nonzero head rows of q_z are proportional while the third is independent, hence its rank is at most2; the 2x2 Gram condition is the stated Bob inequality. Equivalently swap tensor factors, which permutes the full weighted source family.
explicit_source_and_domain: For the exact PPT/SN3 trace24 weighted source in the predecessor, alpha=b=c=q=1 and beta=delta=4. Both criteria become |r|^2<=3. Thus a whole complex disk of non-coordinate Alice OR Bob kernel lines span{|4>-r|3>} yields PPT/SN<=2, and the opposite local map may be arbitrary. The independent r=0 coordinate endpoint theorem also applies; at r=2 this particular Gram fails, which does not establish SN>2.

exact_check.observed: For Alice and Bob separately, r=0,1,i,2 each checked every 3x3 minor of four phase vectors, all 400 entries of the exact 4x5/5x4 output identity, and nonnegative projected PT pivots. Grams were PSD for 0,1,i and non-PSD at r=2; the latter is only a negative control for the certificate. The script hash-pins and replays all ten preceding one-side coordinate checks. General complex r and general weights follow from the written rank/Gram calculation.

limits: The complex disk is a sufficient domain in one tail-kernel CP1 chart; other kernel directions, weights outside the inequality, a general 4x4 theorem, target SN>=3 witness, external/formal review and novelty remain open.
